4.query: How do I earn and redeem points in the loyalty program?
4.expected_answer: Garden Club members earn 1 point per $1 spent (double points on Tuesdays for dine-in) and every 100 points can be exchanged for a $10 reward, one reward per bill.
4.answer: To earn points in The Garden Club loyalty program, members earn 1 point for every $1 spent (before tax and service charge) on dine-in bills at both locations and on website delivery or pickup orders. Members earn double points on Tuesdays for dine-in bills. Points are not earned on third-party delivery apps, gift card purchases, or catering orders, though points can still be earned on promotional bills. To redeem points, every 100 points can be exchanged for a $10 reward, which can be used at both locations and on website orders (only one reward per bill, and not valid on third-party apps). Points expire after 12 months without account activity.

judge.reason: Provides full details on how points are earned and redeemed.
